SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM refunds
WHERE date(created_at) <= (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'as_of_date');

       SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity) /

GROUP BY p.category;

       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS rnk
    FROM totals
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY category, name;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT o.id, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_value > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_value) FROM order_values);

       (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)
       / CAST(m.value AS REAL)
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY 2 DESC, o.id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.category,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity), 0) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.category;

       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM customers AS c

JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.segment;

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM sales
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, name;

    SELECT o.id, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value

       (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)

ORDER BY 2 DESC, o.id
LIMIT 3;

       COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity), 0) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.category;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, name;

reply:
SELECT customers.name, COUNT(*)
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE orders.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

reply:
SELECT topic, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(resolved_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(opened_at))), 2)
FROM tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY topic;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_value > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_value) FROM order_values);

reply:
SELECT o.id,
       (COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor)
       / CAST(m.value AS REAL)
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY 2 DESC, o.id
LIMIT 3;
